sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: regulatory, railroad, work zone and guide signs
Knowledge facts: part C holds 37 fact blocks (sec09-F01 onward) from physical pages 51 to 56; part C2 holds 18 confusable and continuation blocks (sec09-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-SIGN-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-SIGN-D-INTERSTATEMAX — interstate maximum speed conflicts between paragraph and table (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-SIGN-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-SIGN-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: default speed limits (sec09-F11 to sec09-F15), the interstate minimum (sec09-F09) and the work zone fines (sec09-F24) are statutory or commission-set and can change.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
